label: Bytes sent
definition: Total bytes on the wire across the whole cluster in the measurement window (payload + 28 B per datagram).

label: Cross-zone bytes
definition: Bytes that crossed an availability-zone boundary in the measurement window.

label: Convergence p50
definition: Median time until every running pod counts a hit; hits that never converge before expiry count as their full remaining life (a lower bound).

label: Convergence p99
definition: 99th-percentile time until every running pod counts a hit, never-converged hits included (a lower bound).

label: Never converged
definition: Fraction of hits that some pod never counted before the bucket expired.

label: Staleness p99
definition: 99th percentile of truth minus a pod's view for limited keys, as a percentage of the limit.

label: Over-admission, worst key
definition: Admitted beyond the limit for the worst limited key, as a percentage of the limit.

label: Over-admission, mean
definition: Mean over limited keys of admissions beyond the limit, as a percentage of the limit.

label: Receive-buffer drops
definition: Datagrams dropped because a pod's receive buffer was full.

label: Max send-queue depth
definition: Deepest send queue on any pod (capacity 512).

label: Joiner time to parity, max
definition: Longest time a joining pod took to match established pods' view (rollout regime).

label: Deficit at heal
definition: Hits missing per (pod, key) when the partition heals.

label: Time to heal
definition: Time after the heal until every closed bucket's count is exact; seeds that healed only.

label: Expired unrepaired
definition: Hits per (pod, key) that expired before repair after the heal.
